LESSON: KEEPING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social
Topic 2.1.2: Keeping

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Keeping. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state ways of keeping the school  Using video clips and pictures,
2. appreciate a clean school environment clean environment for health and 

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KEEPING
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Keeping helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: KEEPING
Study Keeping like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: State ways of keeping the school  Using video clips and pictures,

What this means
In this part you learn to state ways of keeping the school  Using video clips and pictures,. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: state ways of keeping the school  Using video clips and pictures,.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Keeping” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can state ways of keeping the school  Using video clips and pictures,. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate a clean school environment clean environment for health and 

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate a clean school environment clean environment for health and . You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate a clean school environment clean environment for health and .
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Keeping matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate a clean school environment clean environment for health and . Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Keeping is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Keeping” around your school. (skill: state ways of keeping the school  Using video clips and pictures,)

Example 2: Say why Keeping matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: appreciate a clean school environment clean environment for health and )

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Keeping to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: state ways of keeping the school  Using video clips and pictures,.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate a clean school environment clean environment for health and .
4. Make one local Kenya example of Keeping from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Keeping: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Keeping?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Keeping means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: state ways of keeping the school  Using video clips and pictures,.
5. Be able to: appreciate a clean school environment clean environment for health and .

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
